info.title: FPLense API
info.summary: FPL points forecasts, squad optimizer, season replay and team tools.
info.description: Prices are integer tenths of £1m (55 = £5.5m). Expected points come from a LightGBM model validated walk-forward; hindsight-best squads are the best legal £100m squads on actual points (not FPL's Dream Team). Not affiliated with the Premier League.

get.description: Liveness plus what's published (cheap: the frontend polls it to detect cold starts).
Season, gameweeks (next, finished, archived live vs backfilled), deadline, headline.
Metrics with CIs, MAE by GW, SHAP importance and the backtest (Model Card page).

schema.title: Response Model Card Api Model Get

get.description:
Every player for a GW: price, availability, rating, photo URL, expected points per GW,
``P_h``, actual points once the GW is finished, and the next 5 GWs' fixtures with FDR.

One player: expected vs actual points each GW this season, the next-GW SHAP waterfall
("why the model thinks this"), fixtures and ownership.
The model's pick: the frozen archive for a past GW, the live best team for the next.

post.description:
Re-solve the squad ILP for the next GW with your budget, horizon, bench weight, locks
and bans. An impossible lock set answers 422 naming the broken rule.

Expected (and, for a finished GW, actual) points, cost and a plain-English rule report
for any 0-15 players; a full squad without an XI gets the lineup helper's.

get.description:
Per finished GW: model pick expected and actual points, hindsight-best, average and
highest manager scores, and the capture ratio (model pick / hindsight-best; a product
stat, not a claim).

One GW: the model's pick (frozen before the deadline) next to the hindsight-best squad,
both with actual points; ``source`` says whether the pick was live or backfilled.

Team and manager name, rank, value and bank, and every GW's points, rank, transfers,
hits and chip, next to the model pick, the hindsight-best and the average score.

post.description:
Best moves for T = 0..5 transfers (net of -4 hits beyond your free ones) and a
step-by-step path from your squad to the model's best squad.

Each slot: squad, XI/bench/captain, expected and actual points, cost, points by
position, captain and bench points. Across slots: shared players, differentials and
expected points per GW over the horizon.

A team code (or a share URL containing one) -> the squad with expected points for the
next GW. Bad codes answer 422 with a specific message (typo, other season, illegal team).
11 starters + 4 bench (in order) + captain and vice -> a shareable code.
